domain: Market reports and market data depth
summary: The prior audit's headline finding is substantially wrong. Its "confirmed live bug" (median sold price computed from "ListPrice") was FIXED on 2026-06-26 by supabase/migrations/20260626140000_get_beacon_metrics_closeprice_sfr_6mo_mos.sql, which the auditor never looked for — it read a stale April migration and stopped. A real, narrower version of the bug survives in get_beacon_price_bands (still on the 2026-04-01 definition, still bucketing closed sales by "ListPrice", and still using the property-type filter that the June migration proved never excludes anything). The auditor also claimed Engine B feeds the homepage city carousel: false — app/actions/home.ts is 100% dead code (every export unreferenced; lib/data/market/getRegionPulse.ts documents replacing it), and the homepage runs on Engine A. It missed a THIRD engine entirely: app/actions/market-reports.ts aggregates listing_tile_mv and feeds the Sunday /api/cron/market-report job and every published /reports/[slug] and /reports/sales page. It also missed that components/reports/MarketHealthGauge, PredictiveInsights, LivePulseBanner, FreshnessBadge and StatCard are dead files imported by nothing, that MarketDetailStats renders only in the subdivision branch where its data is hardcoded null, that PriceBandTable on every city report is a literal empty-array stub, and that the HousingWire context card is an unconfigured no-op. The historical-depth, chart-tabbing, and CTA-misroute findings hold and are, if anything, understated.

items.requirement: Comprehensive metric set on par with HousingWire Tracker / Logan Mohtashami framework
items.evidence: components/site/MarketDetailStats.tsx lines 165-269 surfaces 10 rich metrics (median sale, $/sqft, sale-to-list, DOM, sold count, volume, active, cash purchase share, market health, median concessions) — but app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx line 781 renders it ONLY in the subdivision branch (the city branch returns at line 673), and line 361-363 hardcodes detail=null for every non-city geo, and MarketDetailStats.tsx line 144 is `if (!detail) return null`. Net: that section renders nothing, ever. app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx lines 787-793 pass `items={[]}` to PriceBandTable with the comment "stubbed until DAL price-band aggregation exists". components/reports/MarketHealthGauge.tsx, PredictiveInsights.tsx, LivePulseBanner.tsx, FreshnessBadge.tsx, StatCard.tsx are imported by zero files (verified by repo-wide grep excluding components/reports/). app/actions/housingwire.ts lines 21-24 returns {data:null} unless HOUSINGWIRE_API_KEY is set; grep of .env.local returns 0 matches. Only reachable metric surface is KbMarketHud via KbMarketData (app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx lines 509-506): active, closed30, medianList, saleToList, daysToPending, monthsSupply, one trend, one byTown ladder.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: auditor rated this "partial" and said the rich section exists but is thin. It is worse — every richer surface is unreachable.] MarketDetailStats is dead in practice (rendered only where its input is hardcoded null). PriceBandTable ships an empty array on every city report. Five components/reports visualization components are orphaned files. The HousingWire context card is an unconfigured stub returning null. So absorption rate, pending-to-active, pct sold over/under/at asking, expired rate, sell-through, net inventory change, new-construction share, dom_distribution, price_tier_breakdown, cash_purchase_pct, affordability PITI, listing quality score, bedroom and property-type breakdowns reach ZERO pixels. This is "missing", not "partial".

items.requirement: Charts must be quick and tab through chart types for a specific community
items.evidence: Repo-wide grep for TabsTrigger/TabsList across app/ and components/ filtered to market/report/chart filenames returns zero matches. components/site/kb/KbMarketChart.client.tsx line 287-303 renders per-YEAR toggle buttons (aria-pressed), not chart types; a single hand-rolled SVG polyline of median price. app/reports/explore/ExploreClient.tsx lines 6-15 imports fixed recharts LineChart/Bar/BarChart; no metric or chart-type switcher exists in its state (lines 128-152 are all filter state). components/reports/SalesReportCharts.tsx is the only other chart module and is also fixed-form.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] No chart-type or metric tabbing exists anywhere in the market surface. Adding to the auditor's finding: the two chart implementations are also technologically forked (hand-rolled SVG on the KB city/homepage pages, recharts on /reports/explore), so a shared tabbing component has to reconcile two rendering stacks, not one. Speed is fine on the server-fetched KB chart; /reports/explore round-trips a server action on every apply.

items.requirement: Clicking through from a city page's market section lands on a FULLY POPULATED report, not a blank create-your-report page
items.evidence: components/site/kb/KbMarketHud.client.tsx line 265: `<Link href="/housing-market/reports" className="btn ghost">See the full market report</Link>` — literal, and the component's props (lines 37-60: data, eyebrow, chartScopeLabel, asOf, byTownKind) carry no citySlug or href override. Confirmed rendered on app/page.tsx:228 (region), app/housing-market/central-oregon/page.tsx:425, app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx (city branch), app/cities/[slug]/page.tsx:590, app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug]/page.tsx:506. The destination app/housing-market/reports/page.tsx is a 2-line re-export of app/reports/page.tsx, which IS server-prefetched (lines 34-37: getReportCities + getMarketReportData + MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES) — not blank, but generic across 11 fixed cities.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Confirmed exactly as reported, and the blast radius is wider than the auditor said — the same hardcoded CTA fires on the homepage, the Central Oregon region page, every /cities/<slug> page, AND every /cities/<slug>/<neighborhood> page, not just the two surfaces named. A reader on Tetherow's neighborhood page is sent to an 11-city hub that does not contain Tetherow at all.

items.requirement: Front-end and back-end (and emailed/CRM) reports must use the SAME engine — no duplicated stat computation
items.evidence: THREE engines, not two. ENGINE A (cache-backed, correct): lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts + getCityMarketDetail.ts + getPriceHistory.ts — used by app/page.tsx:3-7,92,97, app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx:356-366, app/cities/[slug]/page.tsx, and lib/data/crm/getMarketReportData.ts:54-56 (CRM email). ENGINE B (raw-listings RPC): app/actions/reports.ts:58 rpc('get_city_period_metrics') and :123 rpc('get_city_price_bands') → get_beacon_metrics / get_beacon_price_bands. Consumed by app/actions/market-report.ts:53-55, app/reports/page.tsx:35, app/reports/explore/ExploreClient.tsx:26-28, app/api/reports/export/route.ts:8, app/admin/(protected)/reports/custom/CustomReportBuilder.tsx:12, app/admin/(protected)/analytics/_components/CityReportSection.tsx:10. ENGINE C (missed entirely by the auditor): app/actions/market-reports.ts:277 getMarketReportData aggregates listing_tile_mv via getListingTiles (lines 316-325), consumed by app/actions/generate-market-report.ts:5, which is invoked by app/api/cron/market-report/route.ts:2 (registered in vercel.json, `0 14 * * 0`) and produces the published /reports/[slug] weekly reports and /reports/sales/[city]/[period]. ON THE BUG CLAIM: supabase/migrations/20260626140000_get_beacon_metrics_closeprice_sfr_6mo_mos.sql lines 80-102 replaced median_price and median_ppsf with "ClosePrice", replaced the broken property-type filter with an explicit property_sub_type='Single Family Residence' whitelist (lines 45-51), and switched inventory_months to the 6-month base (lines 121-123) — applied to hosted Supabase 2026-06-26 per the file header. get_beacon_price_bands received NO such fix: its last definition is supabase/migrations/20260401120000_report_include_commercial.sql lines 185-270, still selecting l."ListPrice" for closed rows (line 211), still bucketing closed sales by "ListPrice" (lines 243-266), and still filtering on l."PropertyType" ILIKE '%condo%' etc. (lines 219-230) — the exact predicate the June migration's own header documents as never matching because "PropertyType" holds the RETS code 'A'.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor's headline finding is stale. It read the 2026-04-01 migration, never checked for a later redefinition, and reported a §0 violation that was fixed 25 days before this audit. It also invented a consumer ("the homepage city carousel") that does not exist.] What is actually true: (1) get_beacon_metrics is FIXED — median sold price, $/sqft, SFR filtering, and 6-month months-of-supply are all correct as of 2026-06-26. (2) get_beacon_price_bands is NOT fixed — every price-band chart on /reports/explore, the admin custom report builder, and /api/reports/export buckets CLOSED SALES by original list price and silently includes land, manufactured, condo and commercial rows in a report labeled SFR. That is a live §0 violation, just a much narrower one than claimed. (3) Engine count is three, not two, and the third one (listing_tile_mv aggregation) drives the actual PUBLISHED weekly reports — the highest-liability surface — and inherits the MV staleness failure mode already logged in repo memory. (4) The homepage runs on Engine A: app/actions/home.ts exports getFeaturedListings, getJustListed, getRecentlySold, getCommunityHighlights, getMarketSnapshot, getTrendingListings, getPriceDrops, getBlogPostsForHome, subscribeNewsletter — repo-wide grep finds a caller for NONE of them, and lib/data/market/getRegionPulse.ts line 6 records that it replaced getMarketSnapshot's 33-round-trip fan-out. The whole file is dead code carrying a live Engine B import.

items.requirement: No blank 'create your market report' landing page in the funnel
items.evidence: app/reports/explore/ExploreClient.tsx lines 129-131: `useState(initialCity ? {...} : null)` — location starts null, and line 149 `hasApplied` starts false, so nothing renders until the visitor picks a city and applies. app/reports/explore/page.tsx line 78 reads `params?.city` with no default fallback. app/housing-market/explore/page.tsx re-exports it. The hub app/reports/page.tsx IS prefetched (parseReportsParams lines 77-93 defaults to MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES and a 7-day range), so the hub itself is populated.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Correct as reported. /reports/explore is a genuine empty-state-until-configured surface, and it is the only page carrying the price-band charts — which are also the ones still running the un-fixed get_beacon_price_bands. So the one page that makes the visitor do work is also the one shipping the remaining data defect.

items.requirement: 10 years of historical market reports for every Central Oregon city (MLS data back to the 1990s)
items.evidence: Code-verified without ad-hoc SQL: app/api/cron/refresh-market-stats/route.ts lines 44-72 builds geoEntries from MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES (11 cities, app/actions/market-report-types.ts lines 8-20) + region + all boundaries neighborhood slugs, and lines 82-105 compute only rolling_30d/90d/365d plus current month/quarter/YTD. app/api/cron/refresh-market-stats-monthly-recompute/route.ts lines 42-56 builds geoEntries from the SAME 11 cities + region ONLY (no neighborhoods) and loops n=1..6 calendar months. Both are registered in vercel.json (`0 7 * * *` and `0 4 * * 0`). No backfill script exists: `ls scripts | grep -i backfill` returns 19 files, none touching market_stats_cache. UI caps confirmed: app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx line 355 `priceHistoryLimit = isCity ? 60 : 24` and line 495 `buildYearSeries(completePriceMonths, 5)`; lib/kb/year-series.ts line 32 `.slice(-maxYears)`; app/page.tsx line 187 and app/cities/[slug]/page.tsx line 508 use the same 5-year cap.
items.gap: [VERIFIED, and worse than reported] Confirmed: no historical backfill path exists, the only monthly-history cron reaches 6 months back, and the UI is hard-capped at 5 years (city) / 2 years (subdivision) at both the fetch and the render. Additional gap the auditor missed: the monthly recompute cron covers only the 11 hardcoded MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES and the region — it does NOT recompute neighborhoods at all, so resort-community and Bend-district monthly history is written only by whatever the daily refresh happens to touch and is never corrected for late-reported closes. Also note the auditor's row counts and earliest-period figures came from live ad-hoc SQL, which the audit ground rules forbid; those specific numbers are unverified here, though the code-level conclusion (no path to 10 years) is independently confirmed.

items.requirement: Geo granularity — city / neighborhood / subdivision / resort community report coverage
items.evidence: City: 11 hardcoded cities only (app/actions/market-report-types.ts lines 8-20; lib/cities.ts PRIMARY_CITIES lists 9). Neighborhood: app/api/cron/refresh-market-stats/route.ts lines 49-70 pulls every geo_type='neighborhood' geo_slug from boundaries and refreshes it daily, and app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug]/page.tsx line 177 DOES call getMarketPulse({geoType:'neighborhood'}) with a listing_tile_mv fallback at line 222 (`pulse?.activeCount ?? boundaryMapData.pins.length`) and a city-level chart fallback at lines 385-386 with an honest chartScopeLabel at line 509. Subdivision: app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx lines 361-363 hardcodes `isCity ? getCityMarketDetail(...) : Promise.resolve(null)`, and the subdivision branch (from line 674) renders MarketDetailStats with that null plus PriceBandTable with `items={[]}`.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor's neighborhood claim overstates the damage and was sourced from a memory note and docs/DATABASE_FOR_AI_AGENTS.md, not code.] The neighborhood page does call getMarketPulse for its own geo AND has a coded listing_tile_mv fallback for active count and a labelled city-level chart fallback, so it is not the dead surface described. What IS confirmed from source: subdivision scope has no cache-backed detail by construction (hardcoded null), its two rich sections both render empty, and only 11 cities are ever refreshed. Whether market_pulse_live actually holds neighborhood rows is not verifiable from source and should not be asserted either way without a live check.

items.evidence: components/reports/ReportsByCityView.tsx lines 27-31 RANGE_OPTIONS = 7/14/30 days, rendered as a Select at lines 96-110, only on the /housing-market/reports hub. components/site/kb/KbMarketChart.client.tsx lines 287-303 renders per-year toggle buttons on the price chart only. app/reports/explore/ExploreClient.tsx has a presetId + custom start/end date range (lines 137-140). No lookback control exists for the KPI row in KbMarketHud (components/site/kb/KbMarketHud.client.tsx Kpi at lines 13-21 takes a static value).
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Three inconsistent time-control patterns across three surfaces (7/14/30 Select on the hub, per-year chips on the KB chart, preset+custom date range on explore), none of which lets a reader change the lookback for the headline KPIs on the city report that actually has the good data. The rolling_30d / rolling_90d / rolling_365d / monthly / quarterly / ytd period_type rows the daily cron already writes are unused for this.

shared_primitives_needed: Fix get_beacon_price_bands NOW as a standalone hotfix: it is the only surviving live §0 defect in this domain — closed-sale bands bucketed by "ListPrice" and a property-type predicate that filters nothing, both already proven wrong and already fixed in its sibling get_beacon_metrics on 2026-06-26. Port that migration's ClosePrice + property_sub_type whitelist into the price-bands function.

A single canonical market-stats DAL (lib/data/market/*) that every surface reads through, and retirement of BOTH duplicate engines: the get_beacon_* RPC path (app/actions/reports.ts) and the listing_tile_mv aggregation path (app/actions/market-reports.ts) that silently drives the published weekly /reports/[slug] output via the Sunday cron.

Delete the dead code that makes this domain look richer than it is: app/actions/home.ts in full (zero callers, still imports Engine B), components/reports/{MarketHealthGauge,PredictiveInsights,LivePulseBanner,FreshnessBadge,StatCard}.tsx (zero importers), and either wire MarketDetailStats into the city branch with real data or remove it and the empty PriceBandTable stub.

A historical backfill job for market_stats_cache monthly rows (cities + region + neighborhoods) back to a decided start year, plus widening the monthly recompute cron beyond the 11 hardcoded MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES and beyond its 6-month reach.

A reusable chart-type/metric tab component — which first requires collapsing the two forked chart stacks (hand-rolled SVG in components/site/kb/KbMarketChart.client.tsx vs recharts in app/reports/explore) onto one.

A geo-aware canonical-report href resolver so KbMarketHud's hardcoded /housing-market/reports CTA (used on the homepage, the region page, every city page and every neighborhood page) points at the geo the reader is actually on.
open_questions_for_owner: The ListPrice→ClosePrice fix landed for get_beacon_metrics on 2026-06-26 but never for get_beacon_price_bands. Do you want the price-bands function patched the same way this week, or the whole get_beacon_* path decommissioned in favor of the cache DAL?

There are three stat engines, and the one nobody flagged (listing_tile_mv aggregation in app/actions/market-reports.ts) is what generates the PUBLISHED weekly reports every Sunday. Do you want that path frozen until it is migrated, given it inherits the materialized-view staleness failure mode?
How far back should the historical backfill go: a literal 10 years, or further, and which year do you consider the earliest MLS data safe to publish as market fact?
Which of the unsurfaced metrics do you want first, and should MarketDetailStats be revived into the city report (it already renders cash-purchase share, market health and concessions) or replaced?
Should the 11 hardcoded MARKET_REPORT_DEFAULT_CITIES stay the coverage boundary for cached reports, or should coverage follow the boundaries table like the daily neighborhood refresh already does?
